tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Page and post background. Deep Leonida night. Every slide, cover and profile graphic sits on it.

tokens.name: night-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and panels on night. Never the only thing that separates two areas.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Top of the sunset sky and scene backgrounds. Text on sky is ink or muted only, never pink.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text on night, night-raised and sky. Headlines and body copy.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on night, night-raised and sky: captions, credit lines, slide numbers.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Neon pink: hook words and the main accent. Text in pink only on night and night-raised.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Sunset orange: highlights, numbers and the lower sky. Second accent.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Sun gold: the sun disc and small highlights. Text in gold only on night, night-raised and sky in the dark theme.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Turquoise neon: links, tags, handle and the grid horizon. Third accent, used least.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a pink, orange, gold or cyan fill. Never ink on an accent fill.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps between icon and label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and the page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: slide-margin
tokens.usage: Safe margin on every side of a 1080x1350 slide. Keep the cover text inside it so the grid crop never cuts it.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small tags and chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and color blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and the profile photo circle.
